buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder must submit a registration certificate under category “D” in the integrated registration syste m of the Public Works Department, Chhattisgarh 2. If it is a partnership firm, the registration certificate and partnership deed must be attached. 3. PAN Card 4. GST Registration. 5. EPF Registration. 6. ESIC Registration. 7. Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the last two years. 8. Experience Certificate of similar nature of work. 9. Turnover Certificate certified by CA with UDIN Number. 10. Bank Solvency Certificate equal to or more than 15% of the tender estimate amount not older than 12 months. 11. Affidavit of Not Being Blacklisted on ₹100 non-judicial stamp paper, original affidavit declaring that the bidder is not blacklisted by any department/institution. Submission Instructions Online Submission (before bid end date): * All documents from point (1) to (11) must be notarized copies and submitted online. Physical Submission (must reach before bid closing date): * Along with online submission, the original copies of affidavit and earnest money deposit must be sent ph ysically by speed post to the concerned authority. .
